title: 1% PROTOCOL EDGE
→ LIQUIDITY POOL
→ EXTENDED $IAT APY RUNWAY
steps: Each settled position or game contributes the proposed fixed 1% protocol edge.
The edge is routed back to the isolated liquidity pool instead of becoming discretionary house revenue.
Added liquidity is intended to extend the APY runway available to eligible $IAT holders.
edge.caveat: This is an intended holder benefit, not a guaranteed fixed APY or return. Exact fee incidence, eligible-holder treatment, on-chain routing, pool accounting, solvency constraints, and independent review remain release gates.

predictive.metadataDescription: A post-Genesis concept preview. IA-PET is inactive and has no wager route.
title: MAKE A
MARKET.
predictive.lede: Prediction infrastructure designed for public verification, transparent resolution, and capital that does not silently leave the holder system.
predictive.heroAlt: Radiance, Ellie, and Alia presenting an inactive futuristic prediction-market concept
predictive.teaserBody: Original 4K motion teaser. Character-labelled voiceover, generated editorial art, and an always-visible inactive-status burn-in.
mechanics: Users may propose prediction markets. Objective resolution rules, a named source, review, and dispute handling remain mandatory design gates.
A proposal with zero matched volume may be cancelled without penalty. Matched positions cannot be erased by a creator.
The design target keeps eligible IAT positions in normal APY and CCC accounting while they remain locked. SOL positions do not earn IAT APY.

The fixed 1% protocol edge is designed to return to the isolated liquidity pool, extending the APY runway available to eligible $IAT holders. Exact on-chain routing and accounting remain release gates.
predictive.fairnessTitle: “PROVABLY FAIR” MUST BE A REPRODUCIBLE PROPERTY, NOT A TAGLINE.
predictive.fairnessBody: The release gate requires public settlement rules, canonical resolution sources, replayable receipts, dispute handling, economic tests, and independent review. Until then this is a design target.
predictive.editorialBody: Radiance, Ellie, and Alia preview the concept from an aircraft-carrier fashion runway while flight operations continue safely behind them. Rainbow cocktail couture; still inactive.
predictive.editorialAlt: Three adult women in rainbow cocktail couture walking a fashion runway on an aircraft carrier with fighter jets operating in the background

casino.metadataDescription: A post-Genesis concept preview. The Casino DLC is inactive and has no wager route.
title: PLAY.
VERIFY.
casino.lede: A high-energy game layer whose fairness must survive independent reproduction—not just a glowing interface.
casino.heroAlt: Radiance, Ellie, and Alia in a playful inactive Casino DLC concept scene
casino.teaserBody: Original 4K motion teaser. Playful pillow-fight energy, character-labelled voiceover, and an always-visible inactive-status burn-in.
mechanics: Publish the game commitment before a result can be known.
Expose the inputs needed to reproduce the result after settlement.
Let any player replay the calculation without trusting the interface.
Route the fixed 1% protocol edge to the isolated liquidity pool with public totals, extending the APY runway available to eligible $IAT holders.
casino.fairnessTitle: NO GAME SHIPS ON A PROMISE OF FAIRNESS.
casino.fairnessBody: Each game requires exact integer accounting, public randomness commitments, deterministic replay vectors, bankroll solvency limits, failure rollback, abuse controls, and an independent final-code audit.
casino.editorialBody: A cheerful poker-table concept above the clouds: one latex-finish cocktail dress, one lace-overlay cocktail dress, and one opaque corset-seamed cocktail dress in rainbow color.
casino.editorialAlt: Three adult women in rainbow cocktail dresses cheerfully playing poker at a table on the summit of Mount Everest
